## Summary

Describe the visible or behavioral change.

## Why it belongs in CyberStage

Explain the production, teaching, accessibility, or project-maintenance value.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] Visible changes were reviewed at desktop and narrow viewport sizes.
- [ ] Keyboard interaction and focus remain usable.
- [ ] Reduced-motion behavior remains usable.

## Safety invariants

- [ ] No live transport, scanning, command execution, or remote asset was added.
- [ ] Imported scene data remains declarative and validated.
- [ ] Scene-provided strings remain escaped.
- [ ] Examples use only fictional identifiers and documentation-only address ranges.
- [ ] The CSP and source capability guard remain intact.

## Visual evidence

Add a screenshot or short recording for visible changes. Remove private information.
